summary: Updated four workflow specification documents to describe PM pipeline routing logic for IN_PROGRESS WPs. (1) handoff.md §13.1: added step 2b pseudocode between step 2 and step 3 of the PM Handoff algorithm, plus two design notes explaining PM blindness to intra-WP pipeline transitions and freshly-claimed WP coverage. (2) recommendations.md §14.1.2: added ROUTE_PIPELINE_AGENT as priority 3d (after REPAIR_ORPHAN_BLOCKED, before CREATE_WORK_PACKAGES) with full pseudocode matching the §13.1 step 2b guards. (3) edge-cases.md: added §21.70 covering both scenarios (stage PASS → next stage, zero-pipeline freshly-claimed WP) with guard documentation. (4) README.md: bumped version from 2.4.2 to 2.4.3 with a detailed changelog entry.

comments.note: No observations — all four target sections were clearly scoped by the plan. The step 2b pseudocode, priority 3d prose/pseudocode, §21.70 edge case, and v2.4.3 changelog entry are consistent with each other and with surrounding spec conventions (guard language, cross-reference style, pseudocode formatting).
